parsed.text: This packet contains, by panel and node, probability distributions over a 4×4 grid for red and blue roles. Nodes n1 and n2 are uniform in current views. In panel p0 current node n3 has a blue peak at [1,1] and red peak at [0,2]; in panel p1 current node n3 is uniform. Candidate (view=candidate) records vary by command: many candidate records concentrate blue on [0,2] and red on [0,0] for node n0 (single-cell peaks in several command estimates), while some conditional candidates present the four-cell supports seen in the current n0 estimate. Other nodes’ candidate distributions match the supplied uniform or single-cell peaks above. Copied or conditional origins in the packet are not new events or executed branches; they are supplied estimates only.
